verses.translation: For the end, for them that shall yet be changed; for an inscription by David for instruction,

translations.ron: Dumnezeule, lepădatu-ne-ai pe noi şi ne-ai doborât; mâniatu-Te-ai şi Te-ai milostivit spre noi.
translations.grk: Εἰς τὸ τέλος, τοῖς ἀλλοιωθησομένοις ἔτι, εἰς στηλογραφίαν τῷ Δαυὶδ εἰς διδαχὴν,

verses.translation: when he had burned Mesopotamia of Syria, and Syria Sobal, and Joab had returned and smitten in the valley of salt twelve thousand.

translations.ron: Cutremurat-ai pământul şi l-ai tulburat pe el; vindecă sfărâmăturile lui, că s-a cutremurat.
translations.grk: ὁπότε ἐνεπύρισε τὴν Μεσοποταμίαν Συρίας, καὶ τὴν Συρίαν Σοβὰλ, καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν Ἰωὰβ, καὶ ἐπάταξε τὴν φάραγγα τῶν ἁλῶν, δώδεκα χιλιάδας.

verses.translation: O God, thou hast rejected and destroyed us; thou hast been angry, yet hast pitied us.

translations.ron: Arătat-ai poporului Tău asprime, adăpatu-ne-ai pe noi cu vinul umilinţei.
translations.grk: Ὁ Θεὸς ἀπώσω ἡμᾶς καὶ καθεῖλες ἡμᾶς, ὠργίσθης καὶ ᾠκτείρησας ἡμᾶς.

verses.translation: Thou hast shaken the earth, and troubled it; heal its breaches, for it has been shaken.

translations.ron: Dat-ai celor ce se tem de Tine semn ca să fugă de la faţa arcului;
translations.grk: Συνέσεισας τὴν γῆν καὶ συνετάραξας αὐτὴν, ἴασαι τὰ συντρίμματα αὐτῆς, ὅτι ἐσαλεύθη.

verses.translation: Thou hast shewn thy people hard things: thou hast made us drink the wine of astonishment.

translations.ron: Ca să se izbăvească cei iubiţi ai Tăi. Mântuieşte-mă cu dreapta Ta şi mă auzi.
translations.grk: Ἔδειξας τῷ λαῷ σου σκληρὰ, ἐπότισας ἡμᾶς οἶνον κατανύξεως.

verses.translation: Thou hast given a token to them that fear thee, that they might flee from the bow. Pause.

translations.ron: Dumnezeu a grăit în locul cel sfânt al Său: "Bucura-Mă-voi şi voi împărţi Sichemul şi valea Sucot o voi măsura.
translations.grk: Ἔδωκας τοῖς φοβουμένοις σε σημείωσιν, τοῦ φυγεῖν ἀπὸ προσώπου τόξον· διάψαλμα.

verses.translation: That thy beloved ones may be delivered; save with thy right hand, and hear me.

translations.ron: Al Meu este Galaadul şi al Meu este Manase şi Efraim, tăria capului Meu,
translations.grk: Ὅπως ἂν ῥυσθῶσιν οἱ ἀγαπητοί σου, σῶσον τῇ δεξιᾷ σου καὶ ἐπάκουσόν μου.

verses.translation: God has spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, and divide Sicima, and measure out the valley of tents.

translations.ron: Iuda împăratul Meu; Moab vasul nădejdii Mele.
translations.grk: Ὁ Θεὸς ἐλάλησεν ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ αὐτοῦ, ἀγαλλιάσομαι καὶ διαμεριῶ Σίκιμα, καὶ τὴν κοιλάδα τῶν σκηνῶν διαμετρήσω.

verses.translation: Galaad is mine, and Manasse is mine; and Ephraim is the strength of my head;

translations.ron: Spre Idumeea voi întinde încălţămintea Mea; Mie cei de alt neam Mi s-au supus".
translations.grk: Ἐμός ἐστι Γαλαὰδ, καὶ ἐμός ἐστι Μανασσῆ, καὶ Ἐφραὶμ κραταίωσις τῆς κεφαλῆς μου· Ἰούδας βασιλεύς μου,

verses.translation: Judas is my king; Moab is the caldron of my hope; over Idumea will I stretch out my shoe; the Philistines have been subjected to me.

translations.ron: Cine mă va duce la cetatea întărită? Cine mă va povăţui până la Idumeea?
translations.grk: Μωὰβ λέβης τῆς ἐλπίδος μου, ἐπὶ τὴν Ἰδουμαίαν ἐκτενῶ τὸ ὑπόδημά μου, ἐμοὶ ἀλλόφυλοι ὑπετάγησαν.

verses.translation: Who will lead me into the fortified city? who will guide me as far as Idumea?

translations.ron: Oare, nu Tu, Dumnezeule, Cel ce ne-ai lepădat pe noi? Oare, nu vei ieşi Dumnezeule, cu oştirile noastre?
translations.grk: Τίς ἀπάξει με εἰς πόλιν περιοχῆς; τίς ὁδηγήσει με ἕως τῆς Ἰδουμαίας;

verses.translation: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our forces?

translations.ron: Dă-ne nouă ajutor, ca să ne scoţi din necaz, că deşartă este izbăvirea de la om.
translations.grk: Οὐχὶ σὺ ὁ Θεὸς, ὁ ἀπωσάμενος ἡμᾶς; καὶ οὐκ ἐξελεύσῃ, ὁ Θεὸς ἐν ταῖς δυνάμεσιν ἡμῶν;

verses.translation: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the deliverance of man.

translations.ron: Cu Dumnezeu vom birui şi El va nimici pe cei ce ne necăjesc pe noi.
translations.grk: Δὸς ἡμῖν βοήθειαν ἐκ θλίψεως, καὶ ματαία σωτηρία ἀνθρώπου.

verses.translation: In God will we do valiantly; and he shall bring to nought them that harass us.

translations.grk: Ἐν τῷ Θεῷ ποιήσομεν δύναμιν, καὶ αὐτὸς ἐξουδενώσει τοὺς θλίβοντας ἡμᾶς.
